versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G – Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text: (see also USAR.1841 Oil quantity data) Where an oil quantity indicator is installed on the UAV for use by the ground staff, it must be marked in sufficient increments to indicate readily and accurately the quantity of oil.
